# RCFlCtrl.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

RCFlCtrl.sys, labeled as &#34;RedCastle Control Driver&#34;, is a vulnerable kernel driver that can be used to terminate arbitrary processes via IOCTL 0x85000158
- **UUID**: a7d2a088-b00b-4f5c-96ca-7a98070dddd5
- **Created**: 2026-10-25
- **Author**: Andrea Monzani
- **Acknowledgement**: Andrea Monzani, Davide Netti, Antonio Parata | [](https://twitter.com/)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/e53dd75097a7afbb9bdf68713d47df01.bin" "Download" >}}
{{< tip "warning" >}}
This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "RCFlCtrl.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create RCFlCtrl binPath=C:\windows\temp\RCFlCtrl.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start RCFlCtrl
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
